sources.title: Broken LLM Integration App: writeup of a vulnerable LLM chatbot
sources.snippet: A chatbot built to be broken The Broken LLM Integration App (the Broken Chatbot) is a deliberately vulnerable app that reproduces the most common integration flaws when wiring an LLM into a real web app: from leaking the system prompt to executing commands on the server.
